candidates.statement: Order service's postgres save_order calls fail with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size 5 and idle 0 across all sampled traces, so checkout requests to order time out and the gateway returns 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or logs admitted; pool exhaustion inferred from idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable errors.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order ReadTimeout, with postgres save_order failing DependencyUnavailable at pool size 5 / idle 0; gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms order->postgresql dependency. Bounded candidate: postgres connection pool exhaustion in order service.
